title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: No mathematical error is visible on this page. The squaring compatibilities (δ∘i = λ², det_G∘J = λ²) are consistent with G being of rank 2.
Labels are slightly inconsistent: δ_σ in (135) versus δ'_σ = det_{N'_σ} in (134). The next page clarifies that δ_σ = δ'_σ restricted to T_σ.
The first version of diagram (136) is crossed out, so the page is in draft state.

ideas.what: M_{ρ,σ} as a central product (quotient of SG×S'T_ρ×SN'_σ×G_m by diagonal μ2), with morphisms to G, T_ρ, N'_σ, μ2 encoding the local symmetry groups at the elliptic points of the modular orbifold
ideas.modern_name: central product of group schemes; automorphism data of the orbifold points of M_{1,1} (stabilisers Z/4, Z/6, amalgam SL2(Z)=Z/4*_{Z/2}Z/6)
ideas.usually_credited_to: standard group theory; the GT/modular-tower framework is due to Grothendieck (Esquisse), Drinfeld, Ihara, Nakamura, Schneps
ideas.where_published: Not in Esquisse in this form; part of the unpublished 'variations sur l'équation des lacets'

ideas.what: Fundamental 3×3 diagram relating GL2-type G, SG, PG, G_m, μ2 via det and squaring

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a recapitulative list of homomorphisms and standard exact sequences used for bookkeeping. The underlying object M_{ρ,σ} belongs to an unpublished context, but this page adds no new idea.
transcription_corrections: The page number written at bottom left is 447.
The input arrow labelled '1_μ' is probably j_μ (J_μ on the next page), parallel to j_G, j_ρ, j_σ.
The marginal note is hard to read: 'Ou-déviation' may rather be something like 'Sur-dérivation' or another word; it is followed by M_{ρ,σ}. Uncertain.
In the diagram of (134), the right-hand arrows are δ_G=det_G, δ_ρ=det_{T_ρ}, δ'_σ=det_{N'_σ}, plus ε_σ : N'_σ→μ2 and ε_3 : M_{ρ,σ}→μ2.
